method.candidateLedger: candidateLedger includes all 36 source-unit strata used for the page map; strata group material for audit logistics and are not asserted to equal all discrete printed source units.
method.changes: No production data, app code, citations or private source files were repaired or replaced. This deliverable adds only the audit ledger.
